title: Meta-analysis of the risk of autoimmune thyroiditis, Guillain-Barré syndrome, and inflammatory bowel disease following vaccination with AS04-adjuvanted human papillomavirus 16/18 vaccine.

adjudication.design_quote: This meta‐analysis included data from 18 randomized controlled trials, one cluster‐randomized trial, two large observational retrospective cohort studies, and one case‐control study.
adjudication.k_quote: This meta‐analysis included data from 18 randomized controlled trials, one cluster‐randomized trial, two large observational retrospective cohort studies, and one case‐control study.
adjudication.reason: Primary inverse-variance MA combines the pooled RCT block with cohort and case-control studies; no RCT-only meta-analytic synthesis is reported.
